name: International Protection (UNHCR Mandate RSD)

requirements.blocker_text: Must establish a well-founded fear of persecution to UNHCR, which processes asylum claims directly for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (no dedicated domestic asylum legislation or national refugee status determination procedure).

evidence_required.document: Personal account/testimony at UNHCR RSD interview

sources.title: UNHCR Northern and Eastern Caribbean -- Apply for Asylum through UNHCR: confirms Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is among the countries/territories (alongside Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Dominica, Grenada, Haiti, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Sint Maarten) where UNHCR processes asylum claims directly rather than the local government

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines' initial build. Built as draft (not excluded) following this session's established three-bucket humanitarian framework: a real process exists (UNHCR direct-mandate RSD, per the same regional page used for every other UNHCR-direct-processing-group country built this session), and no country-specific negative finding was located for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines specifically to justify exclusion instead.
